headline: Iran threatens 'complete halt' to US peace talks after day of tit-for-tat strikes
summary: Tehran said it attacked commercial ships over frustration with a US-affiliated maritime agency setting traffic routes near Oman. Iran threatened a complete halt to peace talks after a day of tit-for-tat strikes.
why: Attacks on commercial shipping in the Gulf of Oman region raise freight, insurance and oil supply risks for global trade. Investors track these routes closely because a large share of seaborne oil passes through them.
why_moved: Iran's attacks on commercial ships and its threat to halt talks increase the risk of wider disruption to regional shipping and oil flows.
